speech_style: Natural Philippine English educational narration, stable adult female narrator Kore. Warm clear conversational pacing, preserve all negation and qualifications. Apple is the character's name; no invented dialogue.

beats.text: Apple prepares a mock station. Soap is missing and the entrance is slippery. Pause affected work; use dummy equipment only.
A threat is reported at fictional Bridge A. Another route is unconfirmed. Check route, water, shade, rest, contact and return time.
Heat, queues and missing protection combine. Apple asks: “What pauses, what can safely change, and what needs your decision?”
The follow-up card confirms soap and a dry entrance. Visit route and contact remain unknown. Unverified conditions are not ready.
Complete five fields. Brief the pause, alternative and unknowns. Get specific feedback, correct and retry. Peer feedback is practice.
In the role-play, a mock briefing is agreed; the unsafe visit is deferred. Route, contact and protection remain visibly unresolved. Verify before starting. Do not assume the threat vanished.
